lead: Shekhar Kapur is an Indian actor, born on 6 December 1945 in Lahore.
As of 2026, he is 80 years old, and his birth date places him under the Sagittarius sign.
He has 28 credited works on public record and has been recognised with Padma Shri in arts and Filmfare Award for Best Director.
This profile collects the Shekhar facts readers search for most — date of birth and current age, height and physical stats, family and relationship details, education, and a dated career timeline.

sections.heading: Shekhar Kapur — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Shekhar Kapur was born on 6 December 1945 in Lahore, and holds Indian nationality.
Public records name his mother, Sheela Kanta Kapur. He is a sibling of Neelu Kapur and Aruna Kapur.
He received his education at University of Delhi and St. Stephen's College.
He is recorded as speaking English.
